recognize_zh: 這是 PCR 產物的凝膠電泳圖：TCR beta 與 TCR gamma 的樣本道出現紅框標示的清楚分立條帶（單株性），而 IGH 各道只見多株性模糊條帶，支持病灶為單株性 T 細胞增生。
features: Agarose/polyacrylamide gel images of PCR products with molecular weight markers on each side
TCR beta panel: discrete bands in patient lanes (boxed in red) against polyclonal controls, labeled positive
TCR gamma panel: discrete doublet band in patient lane (boxed), labeled positive
IGH panel: no discrete dominant band in patient lanes, labeled negative
Positive controls (PA, PB, PC) and no-template controls (NA, NB, NC) included
describe_en: The figure shows gel electrophoresis of PCR-based clonality assays. Patient lanes for TCR beta and TCR gamma gene rearrangement show discrete, sharp bands of defined size (boxed), indicating a clonal T-cell population, whereas the IGH assay shows no dominant clonal band. Appropriate positive and no-template controls and size ladders are present. Clonal TCR rearrangement with polyclonal IGH supports a clonal T-cell process, consistent with indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder in the appropriate morphologic and immunophenotypic context; clonality alone does not establish malignancy.

ddx.vs: Pseudoclonal peaks are small, not reproducible in duplicate runs and occur with scant T-cell input, whereas true clonal bands are reproducible across targets.
A B-cell neoplasm would show a clonal IGH band, which is absent here.
